author: a
scope: Actual production Chrome with real protected loopback TIFF backend and public known-value fixture. Separate native-display creation; not installed Windows acceptance or independent image-detector accuracy.
checks: Actual canvas native-window/gamma/LUT preview, bilingual live controls and Carbon/Pearl themes; save excludes draft; cancel retains exact project, source store and history
One-click global native min/max suggestion and real full-resolution Keep; source bit depth, bytes, page/sample hashes and display provenance retained
Exact original TIFF download plus one-step Undo/Redo; immutable native bytes remain available for Redo
Saved native-source project reopens only after integrity verification; corrupted original is refused without replacing active edits
A second display shares the original byte record and preserves the first panel and its manual state
Retained original reopens with current plane/window/gamma/LUT for a separate display; real preview/save/cancel, shared original, old manual states, one undo, redo and reopen verified
Each original uploads once as local binary; subsequent previews use short-lived local IDs without repeatedly serializing raw bytes
A deliberately misconfigured external TIFF endpoint is refused before upload, even though the domain is otherwise allowed for literature searches
semantics: Prefill retained native plane/window/gamma/LUT/resolution; preview separate display; preserve existing manual panel states; store original once; keep/cancel/undo/redo/reopen. A derivative opens its native source, not transferred correction.
derivativeChecks: Native-TIFF correction preview/cancel retains the exact source, project and history
Keep records one undo, original display-to-TIFF lineage, separate display-only correction and no inherited calibration; raw TIFF still downloads exactly
Undo/redo and project reopen preserve source access and retained native bytes
Repeated correction refers to the same retained native original without duplicating bytes or creating a false native-pixel claim
Tampered original lineage is rejected without replacing the active project
Removing the native source store and base record cannot bypass derivative validation
A corrected derivative can create a new native-plane display with inherited display parameters, while retaining its own correction/state and original bytes; cancel, one undo and redo verified
